= Welcome =
This is the DokuWiki start page.

summary: DokuWiki is a PHP flat-file wiki: pages stored as .txt files in data/pages with old revisions in data/attic, per-page changelogs and PHP-serialized metadata in data/meta, an inverted full-text/metadata search index in data/index, media files in data/media, users/ACL/config in conf/*.php, and subscriptions/cache/locks as flat files; it ships a web UI plus an XMLRPC/JSONRPC remote API.
